patch_description:
This approach replaces route-level simulated annealing with a constructive cyclic patrol optimizer.

It first builds several DFS-based valid covering tours. Then it repeatedly analyzes the largest revisit gap of every cell. Cells with high dirt susceptibility and long gaps are prioritized. For a selected cell, the algorithm inserts a shortest-path round trip from the temporal midpoint of that cell’s worst gap, directly splitting the expensive gap into two smaller ones.

Because the dirt objective grows quadratically with revisit intervals, splitting the largest weighted gaps is a targeted way to reduce score. Several candidate insertions are evaluated exactly, and only score-improving modifications are retained. This avoids expensive random route mutation while focusing computation on the dominant dirt contributions.
